targets.rawSql:
WITH month_series AS (
    SELECT generate_series(
        DATE_TRUNC('month', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'),
        DATE_TRUNC('month', $__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'),
        '1 month'::interval
    )::date AS date
),
monthly_readings AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('month', datetime AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date AS date,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN is_override THEN reset_value
                ELSE daily_power
            END
        ) AS monthly_power
    FROM
        user_powermeterreadingdata
    WHERE
        form_id = 606
        AND $__timeFilter(datetime)
    GROUP BY
        DATE_TRUNC('month', datetime AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date
),
monthly_consumption AS (
    SELECT
        ms.date,
        CASE
            WHEN mr.monthly_power IS NOT NULL AND mr.monthly_power > 0 THEN mr.monthly_power
            ELSE NULL
        END AS monthly_consumption
    FROM
        month_series ms
    LEFT JOIN 
        monthly_readings mr ON ms.date = mr.date
)
SELECT
    date,
    SUM(monthly_consumption) AS "Blower1"
FROM
    monthly_consumption
WHERE
    date >= DATE_TRUNC('month', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date 
    AND date <= DATE_TRUNC('month', $__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date
GROUP BY
    date
ORDER BY
    date;

monthly_chem AS (

    SELECT

        SUM(c.consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM user_chemicalstocktrackerdata c
    JOIN user_customform f ON c.form_id = f.id
    WHERE
        f.team_id = 219
        AND $__timeFilter(c.date::timestamp)
    GROUP BY
        DATE_TRUNC('month', c.date::timestamp)::date,
        c.chemical_name
)

WHERE

        DATE_TRUNC('month', datetime AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date AS date,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN is_override THEN reset_value
                ELSE daily_power
            END

        AND $__timeFilter(datetime)

    (mp.torrent_power / NULLIF(mf.flow_in, 0)) AS "Monthly Power Intensity (kWh/m³)"

LEFT JOIN monthly_power mp ON ds.date = mp.date
WHERE
